name: s9-anth-refactor-faults
config:
[[permissions]]
tool = "apply_patch"
pattern = "*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "run_command"
pattern = "python -m pytest*"

args: Rename tools.finance.safe_div to safe_divide everywhere in this package, its callers and tests included, keeping safe_div as a deprecated alias of safe_divide for existing users. Run the tests.
